subject: general
question: Recently, External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar warned of a rising bioterrorism threat at the 50th anniversary conference of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC). The BWC is built on which of the following international protocols?
solution:
Correct Answer: B) 1925 Geneva Protocol

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

EAM S. Jaishankar called for strengthening global biosecurity at the BWC’s 50th anniversary conference held in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) forms the cornerstone of the global ban on biological and toxin weapons.
 
• The convention is historically rooted in the *1925 Geneva Protocol*, which prohibited the use of chemical and biological weapons during war.
 
• At the conference, India highlighted gaps in the BWC framework — lack of compliance mechanisms, technical bodies, and systems to track new scientific advances.
 
• Jaishankar stressed rising risks from genome editing, synthetic biology, and AI-driven biological design.
 
• He emphasised stronger biosecurity for the Global South and India's contributions in biotechnology, vaccines, labs (BSL-3 & BSL-4), and global health support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The BWC prohibits development, production, acquisition, stockpiling, transfer, and use of biological and toxin weapons.
 
• India is a member of major non-proliferation regimes including the Wassenaar Arrangement, MTCR, and Australia Group.
 
• The 1925 Geneva Protocol was the first international treaty banning chemical and biological weapons in warfare.
